name: Karabelo e matla ea ho kula (anaphylaxis)
tagline: Ho ruruha, bothata ba ho hema - tšohanyetso.
reviewer: Ho hlahloba ha tleliniki ho ntse ho emetse

urgent.heading: E potlakile - sebelisa EpiPen hona joale
urgent.primary_message: Sebelisa adrenaline auto-injector (EpiPen) hang-hang ka har'a serope se ka ntle. Ebe u letsetsa 10177.
red_flags: Ho ruruha sefahleho, melomo, leleme, kapa qoqotho
Ho hema ka thata, ho hema ka thata kapa 'metso o thata
Lentsoe le hlabang kapa bothata ba ho koenya
Li-hives tsa tšohanyetso kapa maro a makhubedu a atileng mmeleng
Ho otla ha pelo ka potlako, ho tsekela kapa ho akheha
Ho hlatsa, mahlaba a matla ka mpeng, kapa letšollo la tšohanyetso

what_is_it.heading: Anaphylaxis ka mantsoe a bonolo
what_is_it.lede: Anaphylaxis ke ts'oaetso e matla ea 'mele oohle e ka bolaeang ka mor'a metsotso e seng mekae haeba e sa phekoloe.
paragraphs: Ho etsahala ha sesole sa 'mele se sebetsana le ntho eo hangata e seng kotsi - lijo, ho hlaba, moriana kapa latex. Methapo ea mali ea lutla, moea oa ruruha, khatello ea mali ea theoha.

Adrenaline (epinephrine) ke eona feela kalafo ea pele. Injector e ikemetseng e kang EpiPen e e kenya ka har'a mesifa ea serope. Li-antihistamine le li-inhalers ha li nke sebaka. Ka mor'a ho sebelisa EpiPen, motho o ntse a hloka tlhokomelo ea sepetlele hobane matšoao a ka khutla lihora tse ngata hamorao.

facts.heading: Lintho tse 'nè tseo u lokelang ho li tseba

items.headline: Metsotso
items.body: Anaphylaxis e matla e ka bolaea nakong ea metsotso e 15. Lebelo la kalafo ke tsohle.

items.headline: Lintho tse ka sehloohong tse susumetsang
items.body: Matokomane, makotomane a lifate, likhofu, tlhapi, lebese, mahe, linotši kapa maqeba a bobi, meriana (hangata e thibelang likokoana-hloko), le latex.

items.headline: Leqhubu la bobeli
items.body: Ho fihla ho motho a le mong ho ba 5 o na le karabelo ea bobeli kamora lihora tse 4-12, le kamora ho ntlafatsa. Tlhokomelo ea sepetlele ke ea bohlokoa.

items.headline: EpiPen pele
items.body: Adrenaline auto-injector ke eona feela kalafo ea pele. Ho bolokehile ho sebelisoa - ho e thibela ke hona ho bakang kotsi.

pull_quote.text: Haeba o sa tsebe hantle hore na ke anaphylaxis - sebelisa EpiPen leha ho le joalo. Kotsi ea ho e sebelisa ho sa hlokahale e nyenyane. Kotsi ea ho se e sebelise e ka ba kotsi.

signs.heading: Seo u ka se bonang
signs.lede: Anaphylaxis hangata e qala ka mor'a metsotso e seng mekae ea ho pepeseha. Matšoao a kenyelletsa tsamaiso ea 'mele e fetang e le' ngoe - letlalo, phefumoloho, phallo ea mali, kapa mala.

items.title: Letlalo
items.description: Li-hives kapa li-welts tse khubelu, ho hlohlona ho matla, ho phalla, ho ruruha ha sefahleho, molomo, leleme kapa mahlo.

items.title: Ho hema
items.description: Ho lla, 'metso o thata, lentsoe le hlabang, bothata ba ho metsa, ho khohlela ho sa khaotseng, ho thatafalloa ke ho hema.

items.title: Ho potoloha
items.description: Ho otla ka potlako, khatello e tlase ea mali, ho tsekela, ho akheha, letlalo le boreleli kapa la clammy, le oa.

items.title: Mala le kakaretso
items.description: Mahlaba a ka mpeng, ho hlatsa, lets'ollo la tšohanyetso. Boikutlo ba timetso ke letšoao le hlokomelehang la temoso.

myths.heading: Seo eleng nnete le seo eseng sona

items.myth: Li-antihistamine li lekane ho emisa anaphylaxis.
items.fact: Li-antihistamine li phekola matšoao a fokolang a ho hana. Ha ba khone ho fetola anaphylaxis. Adrenaline ke eona feela kalafo ea pele.

items.myth: Ke lokela ho ema 'me ke bone hore na e mpefala pele ke sebelisa EpiPen.
items.fact: E sebelise hang ha ho belaelloa hore ho na le anaphylaxis. Tieho ke sesosa se atileng haholo sa lefu. Adrenaline e bolokehile - ho e thibela ho kotsi.

items.myth: Haeba ba ikutloa ba le betere ka mor'a EpiPen, ha ho hlokahale hore ba ee sepetlele.
items.fact: Ba ntse ba hloka tlhokomelo ea sepetlele. Matšoao a ka khutla ka mor'a lihora tse ngata (biphasic reaction). EpiPen ea bobeli e ka hlokahala.

items.myth: U hloka feela EpiPen haeba u kile ua ba le maikutlo a matla pele.
items.fact: Boitšoaro bo matla ba pele bo ka hlaha ntle le temoso, haholo-holo ho batho ba tsejoang ke lijo kapa likokoanyana. Bua le ngaka ka ho fumana EpiPen.

action_steps.heading: Seo u lokelang ho se etsa - motsotso le motsotso

items.title: Sebelisa EpiPen ka har'a serope se ka ntle
items.description: Ka liaparo ho lokile. Tšoara ka tieo metsotsoana e 10. Ela hloko nako eo u e sebelisitseng.

items.title: Letsetsa 10177 kapa 112 hang-hang
items.description: E re "anaphylaxis". Esita le haeba motho a bonahala a le betere, o hloka tlhokomelo ea sepetlele.

items.title: Li behe fatše, phahamisa maoto
items.description: E thusa khatello ea mali. Haeba li hlatsa, li behe ka lehlakore. Haeba ho hema ho le thata, ba lumelle hore ba lule - ba se ke ba ema.

items.title: EpiPen ea Bobeli haeba ho se na ntlafatso ka metsotso e 5
items.description: Fana ka tekanyo ea bobeli seropeng se seng. Li-EpiPen tse ngata li tla ka 2-pack ka lebaka lena.

items.title: Lula le bona ho fihlela ba fanang ka thuso ea bongaka maemong a tšohanyetso ba fihla
items.description: Sheba ho phefumoloha le ho otla ha pelo. Itokisetse ho etsa CPR. Fana ka EpiPen e sebelisitsoeng ho baoki ba fanang ka thuso ea bongaka maemong a tšohanyetso.

get_help.heading: O ka letsetsa mang hona jwale
get_help.lede: Anaphylaxis e lula e le ts'ohanyetso, le haeba matšoao a kokobela kamora EpiPen. Fumana motho sepetlele.
